title: AppArmor i seccomp
summary: Ograničavanje kontejnera kernel alatima: učitavanje AppArmor profila i seccomp profila na čvorove, primjena preko securityContext polja appArmorProfile i seccompProfile, seccompDefault i otkrivanje potrebnih syscall-ova.
summary_en: Confining containers with kernel tools: loading AppArmor and seccomp profiles onto nodes, applying them through the securityContext fields appArmorProfile and seccompProfile, seccompDefault, and discovering which syscalls are needed.
